    guest_id, guest_name, title, text = row

    summary = await llm_query(f"Summarize the discussion on AGI for the guest '{guest['guest']}' in the Lex Fridman Podcast.\n\nText: {guest['text']}")

results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
